subject: Speculative enquiry: graduate or junior civil and project engineering, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

This is a speculative enquiry, not a reply to a named vacancy. Your careers page invites contact with People and Culture at careers@wagner.com.au, so I am writing about graduate or junior civil and project engineering pathways in your construction materials and project services teams.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge and field engineer.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work. I do not yet have Australian commercial construction employment.

Your project services and engineering solutions work across many Australian locations matches the hands-on civil pathway I want.

I have attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

letter.subject: Speculative enquiry: graduate or junior civil and project engineering
paragraphs: This is a speculative enquiry. Your careers page asks people to contact People and Culture at careers@wagner.com.au, and I am interested in graduate or junior civil and project engineering pathways across your construction materials and project services work.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language: road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage design and documentation in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, with Australian Standards and Austroads guides, Before You Dig Australia enquiries, cost estimates, bills of quantities and risk registers. In 2019 I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewed drawings, and carried out inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials and prepared site, material and progress reports.

I live in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work and am open to discussing relocation for the right role. I do not yet have Australian commercial construction employment.
I have attached my resume. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. Thank you for considering this enquiry.
